## Ornithology Week 7 Practice Problems: Senses

1) What is the functional role of the pecten in the avian eye?

2) Which of the following statements about avian vision are correct? (You may circle more than one.)

    a) birds can see ultraviolet light
    b) birds can see light with wavelengths greater than 700 nm
    c) birds have three cone types versus four in humans 
    d) birds have primarily monocular vision
    
3) Birds have larger forebrains than primates (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)  

4) The avian forebrain is mostly pallial elements (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)  

5) What does the Gandry corpsucle do, and which taxon is it restricted to?

6) Describe at least three lines of evidence for high avian intelligence in birds, focusing on parrots and corvids.

7) Birds are deterred by capsaicin (**T**, **F**, or **It Depends**)
